releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v7.0.5 — Anti-Cheat Guardian & EA Javelin Fix:
- AntiCheatGuardian Engine: Full zero-conflict compatibility layer for EA Javelin (Battlefield / FC), Easy Anti-Cheat (EAC), BattlEye, Riot Vanguard, and Ricochet.
- Zero Process-Interference Mode: Completely prevents handle querying, thread priority boosts, and process modifications on anti-cheat services so game launches never stall.
- Direct3D Registry Sanitation: Cleaned Direct3D registry overrides to ensure 100% clean anti-cheat initialization.
- AI Neural FrameGen & Live Indicator polish.
